critique: The dark background and violet-blue palette feel suitably mystical, and the particle layout changes clearly from t1 to t4, establishing motion. The circular portal silhouette is readable and there are scattered particles beyond the circumference. However, the portal is still a sparse dotted outline rather than a luminous, continuous annulus: individual particles dominate, the ring core has frequent gaps, and there is almost no visible bloom halo. The loose particles consequently read as part of the same dotted ring instead of fine dust shedding from a distinct bright edge.

suggestions.why: Enlarge the persistent ring particles enough for adjacent particles to overlap and form a visually continuous annulus rather than isolated dots.
Keep ring particles alive through many emitter revolutions, increasing occupancy around the full circumference and reducing visible gaps.
Strengthen the bloom around the denser ring core so it reads as a magical glowing portal edge, clearly separated from the fine debris.
